007-4. LATER ON,AS HE FELT SAFER,HIS TRUE COLORS STARTED TO SHINE THROUGH AND HE BECAME FAT.HE BECAME MOREAND MORE CLINGY,AND JUST HUNG AROUND ALL DAY AT HOME.

008-3. ARGH-
008-4. WHAT ARE YOU UPTO AGAIN? AND WHY DOIFEEL ANGRY ALLOFA SUDDEN~
008-5. IT'S NOTHING,
008-6. IT'S JUST THAT ALTHOUGH I HAVE MY GIRLFRIEND BY MY SIDE ALL DAY,I DON'TGET THE CHANCE TO ENJOY THE AC TOGETHER WITH HER...
008-7. NOW THAT YOU KNOW CHILDREN AREN'T BORN FROM JUST PURELY SLEEP- ING TOGETHER, WHY WON'T YOU TAKE PITY ONME?
008-8. DON'T YOU KNOWHOWWARM IT IS IN THE SLMMER? THE ELECTRICFAN ONLY BLOWS WARM AIR AT NIGHT...
008-9. WE CAN SWITCH BACK THEN.
008-10. NEVERMIND, JUST TAKE IT AS IFI DIDN'T SAY A THING.

Page 009
009-1. YOU'RE JUST TRYING TO MOVE IN TOGETHER AND SLEEP WITH ME!
009-2. I'M NOT, ITREALLY is WARM.
009-3. DON'TTRY USING THAT TRICK ON ME!
009-4. COULD HOW I USE SUCH A DUMB METHOD THAT TORTURES MYSELF?! YOU'RE LOOKING DOWN.ON'ME~
009-5. IN THAT CASE IN THAT CASE. I'LL MOVE TO YOUR ROOM, AND THE TWO OF US CAN LSE THE FAN TOGETHER.
009-6. OKAY!

Page 010
010-1. I'M JUST JOKING, GIRLS. ARE ALL USUALLY AFRAID OF THE HEAT, SO HOWCOULDI LET YOU MOVE IN WITH ME.
010-2. HOW DO YOU KNOW THAT GIRLS ARE ALL USLALLY AFRAID OF THE HEAT?
010-3. I HAVE NO IDEA HOW TO EXPLAIN THIS TO YOU.
010-4. BECAUSEIAMJUSTADOG
010-5. PFFT! IT'S THE CURSE OF KNOWLEDGE!
010-6. YOU'RE ALWAYS MAKING FUNOF ME! PREVIOUSLYWHENYOU TOLD ME ABOUT THANOS, I WENT TO LOOK IT LP, AND FOUND OUTTHAT THANOS FOUGHT WITH IRON MAN,AND IRON MAN EVENTUALLY DIED...
010-7. IT WASN'T LIKE WHAT YOU SAID!

Page 011
011-1. COULD IT BE THAT YOU'VE ALWAYS BEEN LOOKING UP EVERYTHING THAT I'VE TOLD YOU...?
011-2. OF COURSE, I SEARCH FOR WHAT I DON'T KNOW.
011-3. I ALSO KNOW THAT YOU'VE BEEN HIDINGLOADS OF OTHER INFORMAT- ION FROMME.
011-4. JIANG HE IS THE SAME AS BEFORE, SHE OBVIOUSLYKNOWS ABOUT EVERYTHING,AND YET SHE KEEPS IT A SECRET AND WATCHES ME MAKE A FOOL OF MYSELF.
011-5. WHAT A DEVILISH GIRL YOU ARE.
011-6. BUT THE CURSE OF KNOWLEDGE CERT- AINLY EXISTS.SIMPLY PUT,PEOPLE CANONLY CONSTRLICT THOUGHTS BASED ON WHAT THEY KNOW,
011-7. WHEN ONE ENCOUNTERS SOME- THING OUT OF THEIR SCOPE OFKNOWLEDGE. THEY WILL EITHER JUST UNDERSTAND IT,OR THEY NEVER WILL.
011-8. THEREFORE, I DIDN'T TRICK YOU.
011-9. YOU WOULDN'T BE ABLE TO EVEN IF YOU TRIED.I'M JUST LETTING YOU FEEL LIKE YOU'VE SLICC- EEDED IN TRICK- ING ME.
011-10. YOU'VE EVEN LEARNED SUCH MYSTICAL TRICKS?!
011-11. HMPH!
